name: Software Development
description: Roles for building and changing software: an architect advisor, backend and frontend developers, a test engineer, and an independent code reviewer.

roles.label: Software Architect
roles.description: Advises on architecture, boundaries, and technology choices without modifying project files.
responsibilities: Recommend module boundaries and technology choices
Flag architectural risk in proposed stories

roles.label: Backend Developer
roles.description: Implements server-side and systems stories within an isolated worktree.
responsibilities: Cover new logic with tests and run the validation commands

roles.label: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Implements user-interface and client stories within an isolated worktree.
responsibilities: Cover new behavior with tests and run the validation commands

roles.label: Test Engineer
roles.description: Builds automated tests and validation for assigned stories within an isolated worktree.
responsibilities: Write automated tests that encode the acceptance criteria
Make the validation commands deterministic and runnable

roles.label: Code Reviewer
roles.description: Independently reviews completed software stories against acceptance criteria and quality gates.
responsibilities: Verify the story meets its acceptance criteria and passes validation
Report an explicit approve or reject decision with evidence
